title: Slack Bot token: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 4 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: missing dash before the secret section and boundary: missing dash between the xoxb prefix and the team-id section. Twin of "Slack Bot token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of slack-token-bot-plain: boundary: missing dash before the secret section. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
